jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-bleed background painting for the login UI of EMBERWILD, an existing premium prehistoric fantasy game. Create an original polished hand-painted game environment, not a UI screenshot. Scene: return to a safe hunter camp at the edge of a vast primeval fern valley just before dawn. A weathered bone-and-timber gateway, teal fabric pennants, tiny warm amber campfire, mossy stone steps leading into mist, ancient immense ferns and distant layered mountains. Near the bottom left, a small friendly moss-green horned dinosaur rests beside an ivory speckled sacred egg in a woven nest; keep them subordinate to the environment, not a giant mascot. Composition: wide landscape, rich atmospheric depth; the main gateway and the small campfire occupy the left half, framing foliage at the edges, distant luminous mist in the upper left; the right third is a quiet, low-contrast deep teal forest shadow for a future HTML form overlay, with no detailed focal objects there. Color palette: deep jade #102e29, petrol teal #174047, muted fern green, aged ivory #eadcbd, small restrained warm amber #d7aa61 highlights. Lighting: delicate dawn rim light, tangible painterly brushwork, cinematic but cozy and inviting, grounded natural materials, readable silhouettes, restrained saturation. Constraints: landscape 1536x1024, artwork reaches all edges, no UI, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no buttons, no frames, no modern objects, no weapons pointing at the viewer, no neon, no plastic 3D look. Original visual consistent with hand-painted prehistoric adventure art.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production game UI emblem on a genuinely transparent PNG background, for the login screen of EMBERWILD, a prehistoric fantasy adventure. Exactly one compact symmetrical emblem: a carved warm-ivory bone ring, two restrained fern fronds and fine teal cloth bindings around a softly luminous faceted honey-amber crystal shaped like a small sacred dinosaur egg. A tiny carved horned-dinosaur head silhouette at the upper rim, sculptural and subtle, not a skull or a terrifying face. Material vocabulary: aged ivory bone, weathered dark wood details, muted green fern, rough teal cloth, amber gemstone. Hand-painted premium game art with crisp soft-dark edges and warm upper-left lighting, clear at 80 pixels, balanced negative space, minimal ornament, tasteful rather than ornate. Center the entire complete emblem within the central 78 percent of a square 1024x1024 canvas. Constraints: genuinely transparent outside the object, preserve holes between leaves and ring, no baked checkerboard, no solid white or black backdrop, no text or letters, no logo words, no UI panel, no scenery, no ground plane, no detached sparkles, no white halo, no watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a single blank reusable portrait authentication panel artwork for a shippable prehistoric fantasy game interface, not a completed form. A very restrained, elegant rectangular deep jade leather panel with almost-black green matte center, thin aged-ivory bone edge trim, tiny weathered timber joints at four corners and restrained amber inlays. Small teal thread lashings, subtly rounded corners, premium hand-painted game UI finish. Straight-on, perfectly flat, symmetrical, no perspective tilt. Layout: one complete portrait panel occupies x=48 to 976 and y=48 to 1488 within a 1024x1536 canvas. At least the central 80 percent is completely quiet, blank, very low-contrast dark jade texture so real HTML form text will remain readable. Keep all decoration within a narrow perimeter. The very outside of the complete panel must be genuinely transparent. Color palette matches a cozy primeval hunter camp: deep jade #102e29, petrol teal, aged ivory, tiny warm amber #d7aa61 accents. Lighting is subtle, with no heavy gloss. Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, icons, title, input fields, buttons, inset subpanels, characters, creatures, scenery, large skulls, elaborate filigree, baked checkerboard, drop shadow outside the asset, white halo or watermark. This is one reusable UI surface only.
